---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "Single-level, panel, multilevel, instrumental-variable, two-part, and Cox systems"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The six examples at the end of the [help file](help.html), run in full.
Each combines two models and then calls `margins` on the combined system.

## Ordinary single-level models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
sysuse nlsw88, clear
logit union c.age i.married, vce(robust)
estimates store mod1
logit union c.age i.married i.collgrad, vce(robust)
estimates store mod2
suest2 mod1 mod2
margins, dydx(age married)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Panel models

Two fixed-effects regressions on the NLS panel, clustered on the panel
identifier:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse nlswork, clear
xtset idcode year
xtreg ln_wage c.ttl_exp##i.union i.year, fe
estimates store fe1
xtreg hours c.ttl_exp##i.union i.year, fe
estimates store fe2
quietly suest2 fe1 fe2, cluster(idcode)
suest2
margins, dydx(ttl_exp)
<</dd_do>>
```

Typing `suest2` on its own redisplays the table, as with any estimation
command.

## Mixed models

A random-intercept logit and probit for the same outcome, with the
model-specific predictions selected in `margins`:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse bangladesh, clear
melogit c_use urban age || district:, intpoints(5)
estimates store me1
meprobit c_use urban age || district:, intpoints(5)
estimates store me2
suest2 me1 me2
margins, dydx(age) predict(model(me1) mu fixedonly)
margins, dydx(age) predict(model(me2) mu conditional(fixedonly))
<</dd_do>>
```

## Instrumental variables

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
webuse hsng2, clear
ivregress 2sls rent pcturban (hsngval = faminc)
estimates store iv1
ivregress 2sls rent pcturban (hsngval = faminc i.region)
estimates store iv2
suest2 iv1 iv2
margins, dydx(pcturban)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Two-part models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
use https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/meps, clear
generate byte any = exp_tot > 0
logit any c.age i.female i.ins_unins, vce(robust)
estimates store Any
glm exp_tot c.age i.female i.ins_unins if any, family(gamma) link(log) vce(robust)
estimates store Amount
suest2 Any Amount
margins, dydx(ins_unins) predict(twopart(Any Amount))
<</dd_do>>
```

## Cox models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
sysuse cancer, clear
stset studytime, failure(died)
stcox age i.drug, vce(robust)
estimates store cox1
streg age i.drug, distribution(weibull) vce(robust)
estimates store wei1
suest2 cox1 wei1, time(10)
margins, predict(model(cox1) pr) predict(model(wei1) pr) at(drug=(1 2 3))
<</dd_do>>
```
